# BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Småbørn

BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Småbørn is a child and adolescent psychiatric clinic located in [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] [^src1] [^src2] [^src4] [^src13] [^src14], serving as one of the clinical units reporting outcomes to the Danish national quality monitoring system, the [[adhd-databasen|ADHD-databasen]] [^src11]. The clinic appears repeatedly across two consecutive annual ADHD-database reports — covering the reporting period 01.04.2023–31.03.2024 (ADHD_2023.pdf) and 01.04.2024–31.03.2025 (ADHD_2024.pdf) — making it possible to trace its performance on the database's quality indicators over time.

In the 2023 report, the clinic's results were notably weak on several indicators. Among 162 ADHD assessment pathways ("udredningsforløb"), it achieved only 13% (95% CI: 8-19) fulfilment of Indikator 3, well below the database's 90% development target [^src1]. On Indikator 4, it recorded 10% fulfilment (95% CI: 6-16), based on 15 of 146 pathways [^src2], and elsewhere in the same reporting cycle it was cited as the low end of departmental performance, with results ranging "fra 18 % (BUA Psykiatrisk klinik for småbørn, Midtjylland) til 87 % (Børne- og ungdomspsyk. Ambulatorium, Nordjylland)" [^src4]. On a more positive note, the 2023 report also recorded that the clinic met the standard for Indikator 2a [^src15], and reported a 75% share (76 out of 101) on Indikator 2b [^src15], as well as 90% (55/61) on another indicator table entry [^src14] and 81% (131 of 162 pathways) somatic assessment completion [^src13].

By the 2024/25 reporting period, the clinic's profile had changed markedly. It reached 95% fulfilment of Indikator 1 [^src6], and its performance on Indikator 2b climbed to 94% — described in the report as "en stor stigning (fra 76 % året før)," i.e., a large increase from 76% the year before [^src8] [^src7]. On Indikator 5, the clinic posted the *highest* departmental result nationally among units with more than three pathways, at 81%, contrasted against the lowest performer, PSY Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium (Aabenraa), at 5% [^src10]. However, the clinic continued to show weak results on other measures: 36% on one indicator table entry among 244 pathways [^src8], just 9% (18 of 193 pathways) on another [^src9], and as low as 0% (5%, 9 of 193) on a further indicator [^src11] — the same report elsewhere placing the clinic at the bottom of a departmental range from 5% up to 86% (Psykiatrisk ambulatorium, børn og unge, Bornholm) [^src11]. The clinic was also cited with a raw count of "38" in an appendix table [^src12] and with the figures "# 6 9" in a 2023 appendix [^src5].

Within the broader ADHD-databasen narrative, Region Midtjylland is repeatedly flagged as a "positive outlier" with marked improvement across the 2024/25 reporting cycle, and the clinic's jump on Indikator 2b (from 76% to 94%) is highlighted as a specific example of this regional trend, set against national fulfilment rates that remained well below the 90% standard across most indicators. No timeline events specific to this entity are recorded in the corpus beyond the two reporting periods described above.

**Performance**

- BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Småbørn opnåede 94 % på Indikator 2b med stor stigning fra 76 % året før[^src1] (indikator-2b, bua-psykiatrisk-klinik-smaaboern)
- Blandt afdelinger med mere end tre forløb spænder målopfyldelsen fra 5 % (PSY Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium (Aabenraa) til 81 % (BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Småbørn) [^src1] (aabenraa-boerne-ungdomspsykiatrisk-ambulatorium, bua-psykiatrisk-klinik-smaaboern, indikator-5)
- BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Småbørn har 75 % andel på indikator 2b (76 / 101) [^src1] (bua-psykiatrisk-klinik-smaaboern, indikator-2b)

**Facility-performance**
- BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Småbørn havde 10 % opfyldelse af indikator 4 (95% CI: 6-16) med 15 forløb ud af 146 [^src1] (bua-psykiatrisk-klinik-smaaboern)
- På afdelingsniveau svinger resultaterne fra 5 % på BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Småbørn til 86 % på Psykiatrisk ambulatorium, børn og unge, Bornh, B37 [^src1] (bua-psykiatrisk-klinik-smaaboern)

**Statistical**
